Class Feature

Once per day, channel the Halving directly and immensely: a large-radius entropic effect where structures crumble, flesh withers a fraction, machines seize, and bound souls flicker toward dissolution. The first time you do this, and permanently after, a piece of what makes you you simply doesn't come back — you carry at least Reckoning Stage I from now on, even on a fresh morning. Something infinite doesn't notice or care what it takes. That was always the arrangement.
